candidates.title: Text-as-accent (pink ink identity) — promotion dossier
candidates.request: the pink reading-ink identity as a promoted, reusable system feature
candidates.summary: The deployment's real design decision: text itself carries the accent (pink family) across every role, with per-page h1 hues and a neon link. Canonised as observed (token-set/colour); promotion asks for a role map, an AA strategy and owner sign-off — the dossier, not the fact.
candidates.evidence_present: 12 text roles measured pink; per-page black flips already provide an AA path; hover/focus pink #f2849e is the state accent.
promote_when: single role map (pink vs black per role) drafted
AA strategy chosen (size/weight minimums or darkened ground variants)

candidates.title: Gallery carousel — repair & controls dossier
candidates.request: a working, controlled image carousel for the random gallery
candidates.summary: A carousel exists as deployed (component/carousel-gallery) but ships broken: all six sources 404, no controls, autoplay only, 390px overflow. Promotion = re-source the images, decide the motion policy (autoplay vs static/controls) and add position affordances.
candidates.evidence_present: Two captured states; showPrev unwired; comment 'Buttons removed for automatic switching'.
promote_when: motion policy agreed (no autoplay, or pause/bounded)

candidates.title: Project gallery pattern — promotion dossier
candidates.request: the project-page gallery composition (float alternation) as a reusable pattern
candidates.summary: The four project pages apply one consistent composition (identical style block: .image1 70% floats odd/even, img 100%) — arguably a de-facto pattern. Promotion requires a width policy that survives ≤736 (currently 820–1020px overflow) and a decision on the shared-style-block mechanism.
candidates.evidence_present: Byte-identical style blocks on 4 pages; float alternation consistently applied.
promote_when: one page rebuilt as the reference
